title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements Payments Desk Sheet — Card Cap, ACH Limit, Lead Times and Lender Funding Period
content:
The payment limits on Vehicle Purchase Agreements depend on the vehicle program of the order.

| Vehicle program | Card payment cap (debit and credit card combined, deposit included) | Largest single ACH payment | Outside lender funding period (calendar days after signing) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Value Line | $3000.00 | $25000.00 | 10 |
| Kestrel Inspected | $3000.00 | $25000.00 | 10 |
| Kestrel Certified | $5000.00 | $25000.00 | 10 |
| Kestrel Certified Plus | $5000.00 | $25000.00 | 10 |
| Kestrel Premium Certified | $7500.00 | $25000.00 | 14 |
| Kestrel Factory Certified | $7500.00 | $25000.00 | 14 |

**Down payment lead time by channel** (the same under all six programs): the number of business days before the handover date by which a down payment on that channel must be received.

| Channel | Business days before handover |
|---|---|
| ACH | 3 |
| Wire | 1 |
| Cashier's check | 2 |
| Debit card | 0 |
| Credit card | 0 |

**Notes on the figures.**
- The card payment cap is a dollar figure for combined debit-card and credit-card money on one order, the reservation deposit included.
- An ACH payment larger than the single ACH payment figure is not taken by ACH; such an amount comes by wire or cashier's check.
- A lead time of 0 business days means a card down payment received on the handover date itself is within its lead time.

**Hypothetical illustration.** For a handover on a Thursday in a week with no federal holiday, an ACH down payment must be received by the Monday of that week, a cashier's check by the Tuesday, a wire by the Wednesday, and a card payment by the Thursday.
